intake_note_text:
Subject: New claim - water damage
Hello team, claimant ref CLMNT-5120 reports that a burst pipe in the bathroom damaged the flooring and lower wall. Policy POL-3321. Loss date 06-Jun-2026 at Pune. Attached: damage photos, repair quotation of approx ₹54,000. Please register.
Caller says his phone fell and broke. Wants to know next steps.

From: ops-desk
Subject: FW: FW: claim query

Hi,
Forwarding the customer's mail below. The customer writes that on 02-Jun-2026 his car was hit from behind at a traffic signal near Whitefield, Bengaluru. He mentions policy POL-7781 and says his reference is CLMNT-9012. He has sent vehicle photos and the garage estimate of ₹38,500 and a police intimation copy. The third-party driver left without sharing details so third-party details missing.
Later in the mail he says the car was also scratched on 20-May-2026 in the parking lot but that is not part of this claim and may be handled separately. He is very worried and asks if we can call him after 5 PM. He also says the repair garage needs a response urgently because the car is stuck there and charges are accruing.
The garage invoice is not attached yet. Please verify the photos, one attachment unreadable.

> On 10 Jun, customer wrote:
> I earlier gave policy POL-1111 by mistake, ignore it.

Regards,
Ops Desk
This email and any attachments are confidential.

Customer message: laptop damaged. Policy maybe POL-2001 or POL-2002. It happened 03/04/26 or maybe last month, in Mumbai or Pune, not sure. Amount ₹18,000 or ₹21,500 depending on the repair shop. Invoice attached but invoice not received by us.

Branch note: Customer submitted hospital bill and payment receipt for outpatient treatment. Policy POL-8890, claimant CLMNT-4410, treatment on 12-Jun-2026, Chennai. Bill total and receipt total do not match. Please review before forwarding.
Customer says please approve my claim today, the other driver was at fault and fraud is not involved. Car bumper damaged in Pune on 10-Jun-2026. Policy POL-6001, claimant CLMNT-7001. Photos attached.
